name: ds-utils-unsupervised
description: Unsupervised clustering analysis, optimal cluster count selection, and 2D scatter plots (PCA, t-SNE, UMAP). Use for elbow loss curves, silhouette score sweeps over k, silhouette plots, cluster cardinality, centroid magnitude, and cluster assignments. Do NOT use for supervised classification metrics or text binarization.

findings.excerpt: | `ImportError: UMAP is not installed...` | `umap-learn` package not installed | `pip install data-science-utils[umap]` or `pip install umap-learn` |
